reason: The hypothesis combines the known problem of Cr–Zr interdiffusion in Cr-coated Zr cladding (P1, P2) with the general concept of a nanoscale nitride diffusion barrier (P26, P28, P39) and applies it to a new material system (Cr/Zr-alloy) with a specific mechanism (blocking Cr and Zr transport to suppress Laves phase formation). No passage proposes inserting a TiN or ZrN interlayer between Cr and Zr-alloy cladding, nor does any passage link nitride barriers to nuclear fuel cladding under both normal and accident conditions. This synthesis of two distinct bodies of evidence into a single, non-obvious proposal goes beyond the literature.
